title: Workspace propagation: .unwrap_or("")/.unwrap_or(usize::MAX) in test files (106 sites across siblings)
description:
Follow-up to bd:JMAP-x2gd.83 which fixed the 13 sites in two chat-server test files. A workspace-wide audit (post-x2gd.83 close) finds 106 additional sites of the same pattern across:

- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/space_metadata_apply.rs (5 sites)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/space_set_kitchen_sink.rs (4 sites)
- crate-jmap-contacts-server/tests/contacts_tests.rs (1+ sites)
- crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/seed_fixture_tests.rs (2+ sites)
- crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/integration.rs (multiple)
- Other crate-jmap-*-server/tests/ files

Engineering basis is the same as JMAP-x2gd.83: .unwrap_or("") + .contains(X) silently asserts false on schema absence rather than failing loudly with 'expected field, got null'. .unwrap_or(usize::MAX) is worse — actively chooses a sentinel that defeats lower-bound assertions, the opposite of what a regression test wants.

Mechanical sweep, same pattern as x2gd.83:
- .as_str().unwrap_or("") → .as_str().expect("<field> must be a string")
- .map(Vec::len).unwrap_or(usize::MAX) → .expect("<field> must be an array").len()
- .and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("") → .and_then(|v| v.as_str()).expect("<field> must be a string")

Priority P3 — diagnostics quality, not correctness. Held separate from x2gd.83 because the bead was explicitly scoped to two test files; expanding scope would have violated workspace AGENTS.md 'only touch files within the task's stated scope'.
